_comment: Slip-construction rules the optimizer must enforce. These mirror book policy, which changes — edit here, never in code. 'flag' rules keep the slip but mark it for manual review; 'forbid' rules exclude it.

prizepicks.notes: VERIFIED live 2026-07-24: PrizePicks hard-rejects single-team slips ('picks must be from at least two different teams'). PAYOUT SHIFT RULE, from four in-app 5-pick readings. The shift is CUMULATIVE in how many same-match PAIRS the lineup contains, and TEAM IS IRRELEVANT:   2+1+1+1 (1 pair)  -> 10x  FULL, no shift   2+2+1   (2 pairs) ->  8x  -20%   3+1+1   (3 pairs) ->  7x  -30% Observations: sjuush(NiP)+stavn(NiP)+3 singles paid 10x; adding V$M — NiP's OPPONENT, making it 3 legs from that match — paid 7x; DarkMeister+bLitz+910- (all The MongolZ, no opponent involved) + 2 singles also paid 7x, which rules out any opposing-team penalty; and 2 MongolZ + 1 Phantom + 2 FUT Esports paid 8x, which rules out a simple 'max 2 per match' cap. VALIDATED 2026-07-26: the rule was used to PREDICT a 2+1+1+1 lineup at the full 10x before it was built, and the app quoted exactly that. Every earlier version of this rule was fitted to observations already in hand; this is the first that survived an out-of-sample check. ENFORCED: max_same_match=2 AND max_multi_leg_matches=1 — at most one match may supply a second leg, every other match supplies exactly one. That is the only structure measured at the full payout. Three earlier encodings of this rule were wrong (max 2 per match; then 1 per match; then an opposing-team ban) — each fit the observations available at the time and broke on the next test. DEFAULT 5-PICK FLEX: break-even 54.25%/leg, +9.1% at the 55.6% blind-under rate over 453 settled real PrizePicks lines. NOTE Arena entries shade EVERY lineup regardless of structure — never pool Arena and standard prices.
prizepicks._bettable_stats_note: USER POLICY 2026-08-02: kills only — no headshot legs in live slips. The backtest does NOT support this (headshot picks 54.6% vs kills 51.8% at p>=0.55, n=1018/1271, difference inside error bars); it is a deliberate preference for the lower-noise stat. Headshot props still flow through ingest, simulation, crossbook, and grading — only slip SELECTION is restricted. Revisit if the tracked kills-only record underperforms the backtest.

underdog.notes: Alt/scorcher lines are payout-shaded and excluded from modeling entirely (see ingest.underdog). VERIFIED by the user 2026-07-24: Underdog requires at least two different teams per slip. RE-ENABLED 2026-07-26 with a 3-PICK STANDARD default. It was briefly set data-only on the claim that Underdog's lines were worse than PrizePicks' (blind-under 51.4% vs 55.6%) — BOTH figures came from a corrupted query that grouped props without league_id and therefore scored roughly half the sample against the other book's line. Corrected, the two books are equivalent on leg quality: model picks at p>=0.55 hit 58.4% on Underdog lines against 57.0% on PrizePicks, over 433 and 465 settled real lines. There was never a basis for excluding it. WHY 3-PICK: at 6.5x against a fair 8x it holds 18.75%, second-cheapest on either board, break-even 53.58%/leg, and prices at +29.5% at the measured rate. The 6-pick flex scores higher on paper (+50.8%) but needs six qualifying legs on boards that often cannot supply five, and its edge leans on 2.6x/0.25x tiers read off a payout page and never yet observed settling. The 2-pick (+19.4%) is mid-table, not the standout its P&L suggested — that record came from betting it against PrizePicks 4-pick POWER, the worst product on either board (56.23% bar vs 53.45%). PAYOUT SHIFT ON UNDERDOG IS STRICTER THAN PRIZEPICKS (user-observed 2026-07-26): two props from the same TEAM shift the payout here, where PrizePicks gives the first same-match pair away free. Encoded as max_multi_leg_matches=0 — every leg from a different match — because the observed pair (Naginat + Santuriano, both NOI, same game) was BOTH same-team and same-match, so the two readings cannot be separated from it. The conservative rule satisfies either. Cost is a few unbuilt slips; the alternative is quoting a payout the book will not pay. Relax to max_multi_leg_matches=1 with max_same_match=2 only if a same-MATCH cross-team pair is later observed paying full freight. The exact shifted multipliers are still unknown, so the shift is avoided rather than priced.
